features.name: Reactive License Request
features.description: Enter a protected media manifest URL and press Play to trigger an automatic (reactive) PlayReady license + individualization request through the ProtectionManager, then Stop to end playback.

A movie-path TextBox is pre-filled with a tears-of-steel manifest URL

expected_behaviour: A Get License button is present
A KeyId TextBox pre-filled with a GUID is present
Play and Stop buttons are present (disabled until a license is acquired)
